verdict.rationale: Vercel's homepage directly claims it can secure internal agents, apps, and deployments with your identity provider. That matches the story's wording, but the claim is a single marketing line with no documentation of how the IdP integration works. The related deployment-protection doc mentions only Vercel Authentication, passwords, or trusted IPs, not an organization's own IdP. Missing for 10: documented SSO/SAML/OIDC setup, a list of supported identity providers, details of how agents specifically are protected, plan availability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can secure internal apps, deployments, and agents using my organization's identity provider

citations.quote: Secure every internal agent, app, and deployment with your identity provider.
Control who can open your preview and production URLs with Vercel Authentication, passwords, or trusted IPs.
